title: RareFinds — Luxury Retail ERP & High-Value Inventory Management Platform
summary: Full-stack luxury retail ERP and collector consignment platform engineered with concurrency-safe 1-of-1 inventory locking, a server-enforced 5-step state machine fulfillment lifecycle, and cryptographic delivery PIN verification.
problem: High-value retail and sneaker consignment platforms face catastrophic double-selling on 1-of-1 collector stock, delivery fraud disputes on high-ticket handovers, and inventory shrinkage from unverified quality control handoffs.
whatIDid: Architected a concurrency-safe 1-of-1 inventory engine using PostgreSQL row-level atomic locking ($transaction) and automated hold-expiration timers to eliminate overselling on serialized luxury assets.

Engineered a server-enforced 5-step state machine fulfillment lifecycle (Placed ➔ Payment Verified ➔ Authentication & QC ➔ Dispatched / Ready for Pickup ➔ Delivered / Claimed) preventing skipped inspection steps.

Developed multi-channel delivery modules including nationwide courier tracking integration (LBC, J&T, 2GO, DHL), store vault pickup with digital claim verification, and local express rider handover protected by cryptographic 4-digit PINs (crypto.randomInt).
Constructed a multi-tier payment ledger supporting COD, GCash, Maya, cards, and manual bank transfers with server-enforced geographical coverage matching and image-validated payment verification.
Engineered real-time financial reporting tracking gross revenue, net profit, and gross margins calculated from immutable unitCost snapshots per order line item.

Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC: Admin vs. Staff vs. Customer) via NextAuth.js v5 and an immutable, tamper-evident audit logging engine capturing all inventory corrections, PIN attempts, and CSV exports.
Delivered operational utilities including print-ready official invoices, packing slips with holographic certificate disclosures, and formula-injection-sanitized CSV exports for bookkeeping.
result: Engineered zero double-selling risks on 1-of-1 inventory, 100% auditable chain of custody, cryptographic dispute-proof delivery verification, and automated margin bookkeeping across multi-channel retail operations.
